commit.message: Changes from updating the RISC-V model

Port to new coq-sail register state with stdpp

* The Sail model now uses stdpp bitvectors, although some glue is still
  needed because they're Z-indexed in Sail rather than N-indexed.
* Most of the register handling is now simpler and more uniform
  (e.g., see `sim_simpl_regs`)
* Sail exception handling is slightly different; when we encounter a
  throw we can't just throw away the evaluation context up to the
  handler, but need to accumulate it under a bind first.
